title: Debug: native module not linked — settings.gradle missing the include
prompt: A native module was added to package.json but the Android build fails with `Project with path ':react-native-vector-icons' could not be found`. The package was never linked: android/settings.gradle is missing the `include ':react-native-vector-icons'` + `projectDir` lines, and android/app/build.gradle is missing the `implementation project(':react-native-vector-icons')` dependency. Fix both files so the module is linked. Return each changed file with its complete new content.

fixtures.src/config/app.ts:
export const APP_NAME = 'rn-bench-app';
export const APP_VERSION = '1.0.0';
